title: Joltin' Shaggy Miso-Marinated Stir-Fry on Salt-Block
description: An energizing Spanish dish featuring a miso-marinate to add umami and richness to the stir-fry. Perfect for a mid-day meal.
instructions: Combine miso paste, mirin, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic in a bowl to make the marinade. Marinate shrimp for at least an hour.
Prepare vegetables by slicing the green and red bell peppers into thin strips, zucchini into half-moons.
Heat salt block on stovetop until it gets nice and warm (be careful).
Add marinated shrimp to hot salt block and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, or until opaque.
Sear vegetables in a wok with a bit of oil. Stir-fry until slightly charred but still crisp.
Mix together the stir-fried vegetables and cooked shrimp. Serve immediately over rice if desired.
